packageRules.description: One pull request for every stable minor and patch update, which the shared preset automerges
One pull request for pre-1.0 minor and patch updates, kept apart from the automerged group
Group Vitest and its packages, whose versions must match exactly
Keep the Cloudflare Workers toolchain apart from the other updates: it moves workerd, the runtime the tests run on, and a runtime change that fails the tests must not hold back the rest
mise.toml is outside Renovate (mise-update.yml advances it within each major), so a Node.js major must move it too
prBodyNotes: Before merging, move `node` in mise.toml to the same major and run `mise lock node`, then update `engines.node` in package.json.

packageRules.description: Group the oxc tools, which change what lint and format report together
lefthook 2.2.2 was published without the provenance its earlier releases carry, and pnpm refuses it as a trust downgrade; skip it until a release with provenance
